# Schema map

Rendered from the pinned SDL (digest `sha256:8313a6f83a2429fffdc9ce6cbdb03cc2808c7b06022040a1e4f36cd2720ae3eb`) by the schema map renderer 0.1.0. Deterministic: no timestamps; regenerate with `pnpm schema:map`.

How to read an edge row: `(From)-[:TYPE]->(To)` is the stored direction. A target written as `(Name ∪N)` is a GraphQL union with N concrete members; `(Name ◇N)` is an interface with N implementers; the members are listed in the union/interface appendix. The executable schema expands every union or interface target into one input/filter family per concrete member, so the "pairs" figure, not the field count, is what the generated API grows with.

## Domain D1: Kernel, identity, time and provenance

Slug `kernel-and-provenance` · fragments W00 · 13 node types.

The parts every other domain depends on: archetype labels, uid identity, bitemporal time, the Assertion that authorizes every source-derived edge, Source/SourceSnapshot/SourceLocator evidence chain, Activity/Agent lineage, Identifier records and entity-resolution hypotheses.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- Which source span supports this assertion, and who adjudicated it?
- What external identifiers does this record carry, and under which normalization rule?
- Which run (Activity) wrote this node, and which policy authorized the answer?

## Domain D2: Actors and institutions

Slug `actors-and-institutions` · fragments W01 · 9 node types.

Organizations, legal entities, consumer brands, facilities, people and pseudonymous/anonymous speakers, with roles, ownership, affiliations and financial interests as asserted edges with validity episodes.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- Who owns, operates, advises or is employed by this organization, and since when?
- Is this brand a legal entity or a marketing name of one?
- Does this speaker have a financial interest in what they recommend?

## Domain D3: Substances, materials, mechanisms and biology

Slug `substances-and-biology` · fragments W02, W03 · 22 node types.

Chemical substances and their physical forms, ingredient materials (branded, botanical, microbial, mixtures), taxa and strains, constituents and nutrients; mechanisms, pathways, molecular entities, species, anatomical contexts, outcomes, conditions and risk factors; the measured-versus-inferred mechanism evidence contexts.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- Which substance is the active moiety of this salt or branded material?
- Through which pathway is this mechanism curated, and in which species/compartment was it measured?
- Which conditions and outcomes does this mechanism influence (derived projections, never evidence)?

## Domain D4: Products, formulations, labels and commerce

Slug `products-and-commerce` · fragments W04, W15 · 20 node types.

The enduring Product and its variants, package configurations, formulation versions and ingredient components, label snapshots and declarations; merchant listings, offers, price observations, subscriptions, bundles, inventory, affiliate links and commerce matches.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- What does the current label of this variant declare per serving, and when was it observed?
- Which merchants list this variant, at what observed price, and who is the seller of record?
- Did the formulation change between the study material and the product on sale today?

## Domain D5: Food, lifestyle, treatments, protocols and safety

Slug `exposures-and-interventions` · fragments W05, W06, W16, W17 · 20 node types.

Food items and exposures, lifestyle factors, treatments and procedures, public protocol definitions with editions, steps, constraints, measurement plans and adjustment rules, observations and protocol results, and the safety layer: adverse effects, safety signals, contraindications, interactions and use constraints.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- What does edition N of this protocol prescribe, in what order, with which dose and cadence?
- Which contraindications or interactions apply to this substance in this population?
- Is this a treatment modality, a procedure, or a lifestyle exposure?

## Domain D6: Diagnostics, measurement, platforms and devices

Slug `diagnostics-and-devices` · fragments W07, W08 · 19 node types.

Biomarkers, metrics, lab tests, panels, measurement methods, specimens, reference systems, assay and algorithm versions, reference intervals and comparability assessments; technology platforms, instruments, devices, modalities, sensors and firmware versions.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- Are two tests of the same metric comparable (same assay version, reference interval, specimen)?
- Which algorithm version produced this score, and what metrics does it require as input?
- Which device or platform runs this assay?

## Domain D7: Studies, interventions, results and evidence assessment

Slug `studies-and-evidence` · fragments W09, W10 · 20 node types.

Studies with registrations, registration and protocol versions, arms, study interventions and their material components, populations, outcome definitions, results and adverse-event results, publications and datasets; evidence applicability, endpoint classification, result interpretation, syntheses and strength assessments.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- What material did the study actually administer, and does it match the commercial product?
- Which outcomes were primary, what was measured, and was the result clinically meaningful?
- Does this evidence apply to the use context (dose, population, duration) being asked about?

## Domain D8: Manufacturing, quality, regulation and intellectual property

Slug `manufacturing-quality-regulatory-ip` · fragments W11, W12, W13, W14 · 35 node types.

Manufacturing specifications and versions, processes, steps and capabilities; lots, samples, test executions, methods, laboratories, measured results, pass/fail interpretations, certificates of analysis and certification programs; regulatory agencies, pathways, submissions, responses, statuses, designations, approvals and inspections; patent families, applications, grants, claims, licenses, trademarks and IP right statuses.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- Which lot was tested by which lab, against which specification version, with what verdict?
- What regulatory status does this ingredient hold in this jurisdiction (filing is not capability)?
- Which patent claims cover this formulation, and who holds the license?

## Domain D9: Sources, documents, narrative media, claims and media assets

Slug `sources-documents-and-media` · fragments W18, W19, W20, W21, W22 · 31 node types.

Source intelligence (authority assessments, coverage requirements, discovery records); documents, text versions, segmentations and chunks; platforms, channels, series, episodes and segments with claims, claim occurrences, relationship assertions and retelling/conflict assessments; media assets, variants, annotations, graph views, figure panels, label regions, suitability and rights records; communities, conferences, events and narrative arcs.

Questions the sidecar assigns to this domain:

- Who said this claim, in which episode segment, and is it a retelling of a prior source?
- Which chunk of which text version supports this answer?
- What rights apply to this media asset, and is it suitable as evidence?
